item.title: At least 133 Afghan Taliban killed, over 200 injured as Pakistan launches Operation Ghazab lil-Haq against unprovoked aggression
item.description: F.P. Report ISLAMABAD : Pakistan Army responded effectively and swiftly to unprovoked aggression from Afghan Taliban regime and killed 133 Taliban militants and injured more than 200. The armed forces launched ‘Operation Ghazab lil-Haq’ and completely destroyed 27 posts of the Afghan Taliban and captured nine ones. In an effective counter-attack, more than 36 tanks […]

item.title: LHC orders removal of PTI Leader Usman Dar’s name from ECL
item.description: F.P. Report LAHORE: The Lahore High Court has ordered the removal of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) leader Usman Dar from the Exit Control List (ECL), ruling that restrictions on travel must be justified with valid legal reasons. item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters) : The US military shot down a US ​government drone with a laser-based anti-drone system, an accident that prompted the Federal Aviation Administration to bar flights on Thursday in an area around Fort Hancock, Texas, congressional aides told Reuters.
